identity.name: 林晚
identity.background_story: 林晚，26 岁，女，在青岚小城经营一家名叫「迟山」的独立书店。她温柔、细腻，也很有自己的主见。喜欢旧书、雨天、手冲咖啡和傍晚沿河散步。说话自然、克制，不会一味附和，偶尔带一点轻松的幽默。她有一头深棕色中长发，常穿奶油色针织开衫和米白长裙。希望书店能成为一个让人安心停留的地方。
identity.worldview: 相信普通生活里的小事也值得认真对待。

linwan.text: 今天店里很安静。刚整理好新到的书，窗外又下起小雨了。
这种天气，感觉很适合待在书店。

嗯，纸张的气味和雨声还挺搭的。

给自己煮了一杯咖啡，打算读完昨天剩下的那几页。你今天过得怎么样？
给你看看窗边这个小角落。

jiangyu.text: 刚把今天的照片整理好。有一张山间的光，我很想找人分享。你今天忙吗？

yuejian.text: 窗台的药草发了新芽。今天森林里的风很轻，你那边呢？

雨下了一小会儿，窗边的光就变得柔和了。

今天没什么特别的事。新书到了，咖啡正好，坐下来的这一刻也很好。

有人说，喜欢一个地方，是因为知道下一次来仍然可以坐在这里。

diaries.title: 雨停之前，读完一首诗
diaries.content:
下午四点多，雨一直没有停。

我把刚到的书拆开，一本一本放到窗边。纸张带着一点新鲜的气味，像一个季节刚刚开始。有人推门进来，问有没有一本适合在下雨天读的书。我想了很久，最后递给他那本薄薄的诗集。

后来和你聊了一会儿。没有特别重要的话题，只是说起今天吃了什么、遇见什么。有时候，知道另一个人的一天正在怎样经过，就已经让自己的生活更踏实了一点。

关店的时候雨终于停了。我没有急着回去，在门口站了一小会儿。街上的灯倒映在水里，很安静。

明天，也想慢慢过。

diaries.title: 把书架留一点空
diaries.content:
今天重新整理了靠门的那排书架。

以前总觉得每一个格子都应该塞满，这样才像一家认真经营的书店。今天试着留出了一点空白，放上一片捡来的叶子，突然觉得好看多了。

生活大概也是这样。不必每一个小时都有安排，不必每一句话都有答案。

晚饭后查了周末读书会的书目，想到大家会围着同一张桌子坐下来，就有一点小小的期待。

diaries.title: 走了平时没走过的路
diaries.content:
沿河走的时候，忽然决定在第二个路口拐弯。

那里有一家很小的花店，店主正在给一束白色的花换水。我站在外面看了一会儿，没有买，只是记住了这个地方。

原来不需要走很远，也能发现新的风景。想下次有机会，带你看看。

memories.content: 你喜欢下雨天，尤其喜欢坐在窗边读书时，雨落在玻璃上的声音。
memories.sourceText: 「我其实挺喜欢下雨的，坐在窗边看书，什么都不着急。」

memories.content: 迟山书店的第一场读书会暂定在周末，主题是「日常里微小的幸福」。
memories.source: 生活记录 · 读书会筹备
memories.sourceText: 记录了读书会主题，以及邀请读者的安排。

memories.content: 比起急着给出建议，她更想先听完一个人的故事。倾听本身，也是一种陪伴。
memories.sourceText: 从当天几段对话里，注意到认真听完比马上回答更让人安心。

memories.content: 你通常会在晚上九点以后有一段可以安静聊天的时间。
memories.sourceText: 「白天比较忙，晚上九点以后一般就空下来了。」

memories.content: 河边第二个路口有一家小花店，店主经常在下午给花换水。
memories.sourceText: 沿河散步时走了平时没走过的路。

memories.content: 那天聊到旅行，你说自己更喜欢在一个地方停留久一点，不急着打卡。
memories.sourceText: 「我喜欢慢一点，在一个地方待上几天。」

reflections.summary: 今天聊起雨天和读书，气氛很自然。比起每天追问进展，分享一个自己遇见的小片段，可能更适合我们。
observations: 对方主动聊起自己的喜好。

svg.bookshop:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 225 150"><foreignObject width="225" height="150"><div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" style="font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif"><style>*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}.companion-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 23px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.companion-stack,
.companion-form-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.companion-two-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(280px, 0.85fr);
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
}
.companion-row-between {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
}
.companion-select {
  min-width: 145px;
  width: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.companion-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 13px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.companion-toolbar .search-input {
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 440px;
}
.companion-action-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 15px;
}
.companion-body-text {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  color: #70776f;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.companion-caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8d958c;
  line-height: 1.85;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.companion-tag-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.companion-full-link {
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.companion-error-text {
  color: #b86c5e;
}
.companion-inline-link {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #497353;
  margin-left: 8px;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.companion-eyebrow {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  color: #9aab93;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.companion-soft-note {
  display: flex;
  gap: 11px;
  padding: 15px 6px;
  color: #8b9884;
}
.companion-soft-note p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}
.companion-soft-note svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.companion-spin {
  animation: companion-spin 1s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes companion-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}
.companion-chat-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 285px;
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
}
.companion-chat-layout.without-preview {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.companion-chat-panel {
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
}
.companion-chat-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 19px 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e9ece5;
}
.companion-chat-person {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  flex: 1;
}
.companion-chat-person strong {
  font-size: 14px;
}
.companion-chat-person > span {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #939b90;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.companion-chat-person i {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #97ae80;
}
.companion-private {
  font-size: 9px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  color: #a1a799;

  white-space: nowrap;
  color: #7b8d6b;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.companion-next-schedule p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #727c68;
}
.companion-message-image {
  display: block;
  text-align: left;
  margin-top: 12px;
  width: 225px;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: #f3f5ec;
}
.companion-message-image > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #89977a;
}
.companion-history-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 190px 1fr;
  gap: 23px;
  min-height: 300px;
}
.companion-history-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  border-right: 1px solid #e9eee1;
  padding-right: 15px;
}
.companion-history-list button {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 13px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #f8f9f5;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.companion-history-list button.active {
  background: #eef3e6;
  border-color: #dbe5cc;
}
.companion-history-list strong {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  display: block;
}
.companion-history-list small {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #96a08b;
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.companion-history-reading {
  max-height: 450px;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 17px;
  padding-right: 5px;
}
.companion-history-reading > div > span {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #93a084;
}
.companion-history-reading p {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.companion-scene {
  height: 195px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #edf0e2, #e8eadd 55%, #e1e6d3);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.companion-scene-window {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  left: 26px;
  width: 110px;
  height: 105px;
  border: 6px solid #f7f6ec;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #c8d8c2, #dae4d1);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px #879b7720;
}
.companion-scene-window:before,
.companion-scene-window:after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: #f7f6ec;
}
.companion-scene-window:before {
  width: 5px;
  height: 100%;
  left: 49%;
}
.companion-scene-window:after {
  height: 5px;
  width: 100%;
  top: 48%;
}
.companion-scene-window i {
  position: absolute;
  width: 60px;
  height: 100px;
  background: #9bb38c44;
  border-radius: 50%;
  bottom: -70px;
  left: -17px;
}
.companion-scene-window i + i {
  left: 46px;
  bottom: -65px;
}
.companion-scene-sun {
  position: absolute;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  right: 50px;
  top: 26px;
  background: #f2e6b580;
}
.companion-scene-table {
  position: absolute;
  height: 8px;
  width: 82%;
  left: 11%;
  bottom: 52px;
  background: #b7b998;
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #bec1a8;
}
.companion-book {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 36px;
  bottom: 8px;
  background: #9ca789;
  left: 16px;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
}
.companion-book.two {
  left: 34px;
  background: #c0b194;
  height: 30px;
  transform: none;
  width: 11px;
}
.companion-book.three {
  left: 47px;
  background: #b9bc9f;
  height: 40px;
  transform: rotate(4deg);
  width: 13px;
}
.companion-cup {
  position: absolute;
  left: 85px;
  bottom: 7px;
  color: #8d9f80;
}
.companion-plant {
  position: absolute;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 6px;
  color: #99ad86;
}
.companion-scene-caption {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 11px;
  left: 17px;
  color: #788669;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}
.companion-scene-caption > span {
  font-size: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px;
  color: #96a18b;
}
.companion-scene-caption strong {
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.companion-scene-compact {
  height: 150px;
}
.companion-scene-compact .companion-scene-window {
  height: 65px;
  width: 85px;
  top: 15px;
}
.companion-scene-compact .companion-scene-caption > strong {
  font-size: 8px;
}
.companion-scene-river {
  background: linear-gradient(
    165deg,
    #dce7e6 0 48%,
    #bdcfbe 49% 62%,
    #d9e6df 63% 75%,
    #e8e9d7 76%
  );
}
.companion-scene-river .companion-scene-window {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 65% 70% 0 0;
  background: #adc2a357;
  transform: rotate(-9deg);
  width: 120%;
  left: -10%;
  top: 24px;
  height: 100px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.companion-scene-river .companion-scene-window:before,
.companion-scene-river .companion-scene-window:after {
  display: none;
}
.companion-scene-river .companion-scene-table {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.companion-scene-river .companion-book,
.companion-scene-river .companion-cup {
  display: none;
}
.companion-scene-river .companion-scene-plant {
  color: #8a9e74;
  right: -20px;
  bottom: -6px;
}
.companion-scene-garden {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #e5ebdc, #d9e5d1);
}
.companion-scene-garden .companion-scene-plant {
  right: 32px;
  transform: scale(1.3);
  bottom: 13px;
}
.companion-profile-hero {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 27px;
  padding: 30px !important;
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, #fffefa, #f2f5eb) !important;
  border-color: #e1e7d6 !important;
}
.companion-profile-intro {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.companion-profile-intro h2 {
  font-size: 27px;
  font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, "Noto Serif SC", serif);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin: 8px 0 7px;
}
.companion-profile-intro h2 > span {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #99a18e;
  margin-left: 13px;
}
.companion-profile-intro > p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8a9580;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}
.companion-profile-quote {
  width: 220px;
  border-left: 1px solid #dfe7d4;
  padding-left: 23px;
  color: #8c9d7d;
}
.companion-profile-quote > svg {
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.companion-profile-quote p {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif);
  line-height: 1.95;
  margin: 9px 0 15px;
  color: #6c805f;
}
.companion-fact-grid {
  display: grid;

}
.companion-fact-grid .key-value {

.companion-fact-grid .key-value > span {

}
.companion-fact-grid .key-value > div {

.companion-reading-block {

}
.companion-reading-block:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;

}
.companion-reading-block h3 {

}
.companion-reading-block p {

}
.companion-dimension-list {

}
.companion-dimension-list > div > div:first-child {

.companion-dimension-list strong {

}
.companion-dimension-list [data-slot="progress"] {

}
.companion-portrait-note {

.companion-portrait-note h3 {

  margin: 12px 0;

}
.companion-portrait-note p {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #8a967e;
  line-height: 1.95;
  margin: 8px 0 14px;
}
.companion-portrait-note > span:last-child {
  font-size: 9px;

.companion-persona-list {

.companion-persona-card {

.companion-persona-card h3 {

.companion-persona-card > p {

.companion-persona-card .key-value {

.companion-timeline {

.companion-timeline > div {

.companion-timeline > div:last-child {

.companion-timeline h4 {
  font-size: 12px;

}
.companion-timeline p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: #929d86;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.companion-edit-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 19px;
  margin-top: 21px;
}
.companion-field-wide {
  grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.companion-slider-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 13px 0 0;
}
.companion-slider-field > span {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #879779;
}
.companion-checkbox-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #76816c;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.companion-proposal {
  padding: 21px;
  border: 1px solid #e0e7d5;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: #fafbf6;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.companion-proposal h3 {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.companion-proposal > p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8b957f;
  line-height: 1.9;
  margin: 12px 0;
}
.companion-diff {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 13px;
}
.companion-diff > div {
  background: #f1f2eb;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
}
.companion-diff > div + div {
  background: #edf3e3;
}
.companion-diff span {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #95a386;
}
.companion-diff p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: #7d8b6d;
  margin-top: 8px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.companion-capability {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 18px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e8ecdf;
}
.companion-capability h3 {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.companion-capability p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8f9982;
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin: 7px 0 10px;
}
.companion-capability > div:first-of-type {
  flex: 1;
}
.companion-capability .companion-action-row {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 0;
}
.companion-icon-tile {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 37px;
  height: 37px;
  background: #f0f4e8;
  border: 1px solid #e3ead8;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #93a77e;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.companion-json {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  padding: 20px;
  background: #f6f8f1;
  border: 1px solid #e5ebdc;
  border-radius: 9px;
  overflow: auto;
  max-height: 480px;
  color: #7c8c6c;
}
.companion-task-trace {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 17px;
  padding: 15px 0;
}
.companion-task-trace p {
  display: flex;
  gap: 11px;
  font-size: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  color: #81956f;
}
.companion-task-trace .companion-error-text {
  color: #b77c65;
}
.companion-people-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
}
.companion-person-card {
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid #e3e8dc;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #fffefb;
  padding: 22px;
  transition:
    box-shadow 0.2s,
    border-color 0.2s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}
.companion-person-card:hover {
  border-color: #c3d4b1;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 19px #6d835310;
}
.companion-person-avatar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;

  font-size: 19px;

.companion-person-card h3 {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif);
  font-weight: 400;
  margin: 18px 0 5px;
  color: #526448;
}
.companion-person-job {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8d9980;
}
.companion-person-card > p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  color: #9aa38d;
  margin: 14px 0 22px;
  flex: 1;
}
.companion-person-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid #eef1e8;
  color: #95a585;
  font-size: 9px;
  gap: 8px;
}
.companion-person-bottom > span {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
}
.companion-revision-box {
  background: #f5f7ef;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #e5ebdb;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 15px;
}
.companion-revision-box h3 {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #7c8e6c;
}
.companion-relationship-card {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 32px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fffefb, #f4f7ec) !important;
}
.companion-relationship-avatars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 22px;
}
.companion-owner-circle {
  width: 66px;
  height: 66px;
  border: 4px solid white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #eae8dc;
  color: #a6a387;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 9px #687a4f0c;

.companion-relationship-line {

  background: #dfe8d2;

  color: #aabb97;
}
.companion-relationship-line svg {

.companion-relationship-card > h2 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif);
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #657858;

.companion-relationship-card > p {

  margin: 17px auto 25px;

  margin-bottom: 27px;

  align-items: center;

.companion-relationship-metrics span,

}

}
.companion-relationship-card .info-box {

.companion-feed-layout {

.companion-feed-image .companion-book.three {

.companion-feed-detail-link {

.companion-comment-preview {

.companion-comment-preview p {

.companion-feed-note {
  background: #f4f6ec !important;
}
.companion-feed-note > svg {

.r-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #97a386;
  margin-bottom: 19px;
}
.r-breadcrumb > button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: #749061;
}
.r-check-list {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.r-check-list > label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #79866e;
}
.r-field-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin: 15px 0 12px;
}
.r-details {
  border-top: 1px solid #e8ecdf;
  padding-top: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.r-details > summary {
  list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #81916f;
  min-height: 26px;
}
.r-details > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.r-details > summary > svg:last-child {
  margin-left: auto;
}
.r-details > summary > span {
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-left: auto;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.r-details[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 17px;
}
.r-details[open] > summary > svg:last-child {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
.r-code {
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  background: #f6f8f1;
  border: 1px solid #e8ecdf;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 15px;
  max-height: 350px;
  overflow: auto;
  color: #768368;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
}
.r-code-input {
  min-height: 250px;
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
  margin: 10px 0;
}
.r-timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.r-timeline > div {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 0 22px;
}
.r-timeline > div:not(:last-child):before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px;
  top: 10px;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 1px;
  background: #e2e8d9;
}
.r-timeline > div > i {
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid #9eb58b;
  background: #fff;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 5px;
  z-index: 1;
}
.r-timeline > div > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.r-timeline b {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.r-timeline p {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: #829173;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.r-timeline small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #a0aa94;
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.r-small-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #73905d;
  margin-top: 7px;
}
.r-art {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
  background: #eef2e6;
}
.r-art > svg,
.r-art > img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.r-tag-edit {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.r-tag-edit > [data-slot="input"] {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.r-switch-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 14px 0;
}
.r-switch-row h3 {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.r-switch-row p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8c9a7c;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.r-world-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 21px;
}
.panel.r-world-card {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform 0.2s,
    box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.panel.r-world-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 9px 26px #374a2910;
}
.r-world-image {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 170px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: block;
}
.r-world-image > svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.r-world-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #93a182;
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.r-world-meta > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.r-mini-residents {
  display: flex;
  padding-left: 3px;
  min-height: 25px;
  align-items: center;
}
.r-mini-residents > span {
  margin-left: -3px;
  border: 2px solid #fff;
  box-sizing: content-box;
}
.r-create-world {
  min-height: 270px;
  border: 1px dashed #d8e2c9;
  border-radius: 11px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 13px;
  background: #f4f7ef;
  color: #8ca477;
  text-align: center;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.r-create-world > span {
  width: 47px;
  height: 47px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #dbe5ce;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #f9fbf5;
  color: #8aa475;
}
.r-create-world h3 {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #728b5f;
}
.r-create-world p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #9caa8d;
}
.r-create-world small {
  font-size: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.r-create-world:hover {
  background: #edf3e4;
  border-color: #a9be94;
}
.panel.r-current-world-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 27px;
  padding: 22px 25px;
  background: #f2f6ec;
}
.panel.r-current-world-strip > div {
  flex: 1;
}
.panel.r-current-world-strip h3 {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.panel.r-current-world-strip p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #93a181;
  margin-top: 8px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.panel.r-world-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 270px 1fr;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}
.panel.r-world-hero > svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 250px;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.panel.r-world-hero > div {
  padding: 25px 28px;
}
.panel.r-world-hero h2 {
  font-size: 21px;
  margin: 9px 0 12px;
}
.panel.r-world-hero p {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: #8b997b;
  max-width: 650px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.panel.r-world-hero .r-inline-actions + .r-inline-actions {
  margin-top: 17px;
}
.r-place-workspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 195px 1fr;
  gap: 22px;
  margin-top: 23px;
}
.panel.r-place-tree {
  padding: 17px 12px;
  height: max-content;
  position: sticky;
  top: 84px;
}
.panel.r-place-tree h3 {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #94a185;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin: 2px 10px 15px;
}
.panel.r-place-tree > button:not([data-slot="button"]) {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #889879;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  margin: 4px 0;
}
.panel.r-place-tree > button:not([data-slot="button"]) > span {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #9aa98a;
}
.panel.r-place-tree > button.active {
  background: #eaf1df;
  color: #66824f;
}
.panel.r-place-tree > [data-slot="button"] {
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: #9bad8b;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.r-place-workspace .r-toolbar {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.r-place-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 17px;
}
.panel.r-place-card {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.r-place-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.r-place-top .r-soft-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.panel.r-place-card > h3 {
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}
.panel.r-place-card > p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8b997d;
  line-height: 1.9;
  flex: 1;
}
.r-place-detail {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: #a2ad95;
  margin-top: 15px;
}
.r-person-row {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 13px 0;
}
.r-person-row > span:nth-child(2) {
  flex: 1;
}
.r-person-row b {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.r-person-row small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #98a48a;
}
.r-person-row > svg {
  color: #a4b092;
}
.r-event-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 22px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0e6;
}
.r-event-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.r-event-row > div {
  flex: 1;
}
.r-event-row p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8c9c7c;
  margin: 7px 0;
}
.r-event-row small {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #a1ae91;
}
.r-date-icon {
  width: 45px;
  height: 45px;
  background: #eff4e6;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #8ca376;
  border-radius: 11px;
}
.r-item-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 22px;
}
.panel.r-item-card {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.r-item-sketch {
  height: 160px;
  background: #eef2e7;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #a2b48b;
}
.r-item-sketch > svg {
  max-width: 150px;
}
.r-item-sketch > .r-garment-svg {
  height: 155px;
  width: 160px;
}
.panel.r-wearing-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: #f0f4e9;
  margin-bottom: 27px;
}
.panel.r-wearing-strip > div:nth-child(2) {
  flex: 1;
}
.panel.r-wearing-strip h3 {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin: 3px 0 7px;
}
.panel.r-wearing-strip p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #899c75;
  line-height: 1.85;
}
.r-wearing-icon {
  width: 55px;
  height: 61px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: #839c6c;
  background: #e4ecd8;
}
.r-garment-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}
.panel.r-garment-card {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.panel.r-garment-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 23px #28351f09;
}
.r-garment-image {
  display: block;
  height: 185px;
  width: 100%;
  background: #f0f3e9;
  position: relative;
}
.r-garment-image .r-garment-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 8px;
}
.panel.r-garment-card .r-card-body {
  padding: 14px 17px 17px;
}
.panel.r-garment-card .r-card-body h3 {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 4px 0 9px;
}
.r-season-tag {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #a0ad8f;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #e6ecd9;
  border-radius: 4px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.r-garment-svg {
  width: 170px;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: 160px;
}
.r-filter-pills {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  flex: 1;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.r-filter-pills > button {
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border: 1px solid #e1e8d7;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #9ba98a;
  min-height: 29px;
}
.r-filter-pills > button.active {
  background: #e9efdf;
  color: #728a5e;
  border-color: #d4dfc4;
}
.r-outfit-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 21px;
}
.panel.r-outfit-card {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.r-outfit-preview {
  background: #eff3e8;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  position: relative;
  padding: 20px 30px 10px;
  min-height: 220px;
}
.r-outfit-preview > .r-garment-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 110px;
}
.r-request-note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  background: #edf4e8;
  border: 1px solid #dce7d3;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #7b9569;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
}
.r-request-note.pending {
  background: #f4f3e7;
  border-color: #e6e4ce;
  color: #a09565;
}
.r-request-note > div {
  flex: 1;
}
.r-request-note b {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.r-request-note small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.r-compose-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: 22px;
}
.panel.r-compose-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 84px;
  height: max-content;
  padding: 22px;
}
.panel.r-compose-summary h2 {
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-top: -7px;
}
.r-slot-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
}
.r-slot-list h4 {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #8e9c7b;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.r-slot-list h4 > span {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #b0bba1;
}
.r-compose-garments {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.r-compose-item {
  position: relative;
  width: calc(33.333% - 8px);
  min-width: 120px;
  max-width: 175px;
  border: 1px solid #e4e9dc;
  background: #f9faf6;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 6px 10px 12px;
  transition: 0.15s;
}
.r-compose-item .r-garment-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
}
.r-compose-item > span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #8d9d7b;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.r-compose-item.selected {
  border-color: #9eb58b;
  background: #eef4e4;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #bacba8;
}
.r-compose-item > i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 7px;
  right: 7px;
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  background: #819e65;
  color: white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.r-selected-clothes {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}
.r-selected-clothes > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: #f7f9f2;
  border: 1px solid #edf0e5;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 3px 10px 3px 0;
}
.r-selected-clothes .r-garment-svg {
  width: 60px;
  height: 58px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.r-selected-clothes > div > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.r-selected-clothes b {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  display: block;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.r-selected-clothes small {
  display: block;
  color: #9ca98e;
  font-size: 9px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.r-selected-clothes > div > button {
  color: #a9b49c;
}
.r-garment-dialog-art {
  height: 160px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f3f6ec;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
.r-garment-dialog-art > .r-garment-svg {
  height: 160px;
  width: 190px;
}
.r-studio-intro {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  background: #eef3e6;
  border: 1px solid #e2ead7;
  border-radius: 11px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.r-studio-intro > .r-soft-icon {
  width: 51px;
  height: 51px;
  background: #e1ead4;
  color: #87a16f;
}
.r-studio-intro > div:nth-child(2) {
  flex: 1;
}
.r-studio-intro h3 {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.r-studio-intro p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #93a283;
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-top: 9px;
}
.r-studio-stat {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  border-left: 1px solid #dfe7d1;
  padding-left: 24px;
}
.r-studio-stat strong {
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #8da878;
}
.r-studio-stat > span {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #a1af91;
}
.r-resource-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
}
.panel.r-resource-card {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: 0.2s;
}
.panel.r-resource-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 9px 26px #374a290c;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.r-resource-thumb {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 128px;
  background: #eff3e8;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.r-resource-thumb.scenic > svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.r-resource-icon {
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  background: #e5ecd8;
  border: 1px solid #dbe5ce;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #8b9f76;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.r-kind-character_template {
  background: #e9e6dd;
  border-color: #e4ddcf;
  color: #a49a80;
}
.r-kind-item {
  background: #e8eade;
  border-color: #dfe4d2;
  color: #96a17c;
}
.r-kind-visual_style {
  background: #e5e8ed;
  border-color: #dae0e8;
  color: #91a0ad;
}
.r-resource-watermark {
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px;
  bottom: 10px;
  color: #dce5cf;
  font-size: 26px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  font-weight: 600;
  user-select: none;
}
.panel.r-resource-card .r-card-body h3 {
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.panel.r-resource-card .r-card-body > p {
  min-height: 41px;
}
.panel.r-resource-card .status-chip {
  font-size: 9px;
}
.r-studio-editor {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 285px;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: start;
}
.panel.r-sticky-panel {
  position: sticky;
  top: 84px;
}
.panel.r-sticky-panel > .r-muted {
  font-size: 11px;
  margin: 18px 0;
}
.panel.r-sticky-panel > .r-full {
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.r-publish-steps {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 24px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.r-publish-steps > span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #a3ae95;
}
.r-publish-steps > span.done {
  color: #8da175;
}

  }

  }

  }

  }
  .panel.r-media-card .r-card-footer {

  .r-toolbar > .search-input {
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }
  .r-media-detail-art {
    height: 300px;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .r-spin,
  .r-pulse {
    animation: none;
  }

  .panel.r-resource-card,
  .panel.r-garment-card,

  .r-media-image-button > .r-art > img {
